info.name: Shared manual journal entries
info.description: Manual journals for active shared centers are stored in master with the actual selected cost_center_id. Existing automated shared accounting at ID 0 is unchanged. The master branch_id response marker remains null; cost_center_id retains the selected shared ID. Items are owned through their parent journal. No live requests were executed as part of local validation.

request.description: Select an active shared ID returned by branch metadata. Unknown/deleted centers are rejected. Existing item, permission, and approval-stage rules remain unchanged. Updates with an existing item id must reference an active item of this journal; omitted IDs insert replacements and soft-delete omitted existing items. Header/items are atomic on the resolved database connection.
